# Scene-first invention · S09

Ordered moments distinguish the person, trigger, known and unknown information, available actions and stakes. Drag moments to reorder and interventions to place them, or use labelled controls. Vary the person, information or timing in a new scene while retaining the original and a frozen source record. Follow branches, park variations, and keep independent intervention versions in each scene.

Compare up to four scenes and four interventions. Each fit judgement belongs to a scene and retains its reviewed context; changes to the situation, sequence, person, information, placement or intervention request another review without erasing reasoning. Branch interventions, copy them unplaced into another scene, and choose a rehearsal with a decision note. Judgements are user hypotheses, never generated scores.

Existing single-scene saves upgrade in place. The creative-kit provides local persistence, grouped Undo, recovery/cross-tab pause and Markdown/JSON export. Limits: 12 scenes per workspace, 8 moments and 24 interventions per scene, 100 workspaces and portable work under 8 MB. Ancestry snapshots stay flat; ancestors with descendants cannot be removed. State tests cover migration, independent branches, review invalidation, references, export and atomic rejection.
